after_snippet:
# In pytest 9.0.0, Python 3.10+ is required

import sys

# pytest 9.0.0 requires Python 3.10 or later
# Update your Python version or stay on pytest 8.4.2
if sys.version_info >= (3, 10):
    import pytest
    # pytest 9.0.0 will work on Python 3.10+
    pass
elif sys.version_info >= (3, 9):
    # For Python 3.9, use pytest 8.4.2 instead
    raise RuntimeError("pytest 9.0.0 requires Python 3.10+")
before_snippet:
# In pytest 8.4.2, pytest supported Python 3.9
# In 9.0.0, Python 3.9 is no longer supported

import sys

# This would work in pytest 8.4.2 on Python 3.9
# but pytest 9.0.0 requires Python 3.10+
if sys.version_info >= (3, 9):
    import pytest
    # If running on Python 3.9, pytest 9.0.0 will not be installable
    # This is a package-level breaking change
    pass
title: Python 3.9 support dropped
